locations.name: Iron Route
locations.note: CITED: runs WEST from Phlan to Zhentil Keep, skirting the northern coast of the Moonsea (DDEX1-9 p.2 'west along the Iron Route'; p.6 'skirts the northern coast'; p.13 route to King's Pyre 40 mi west; AL Player's Guide to Phlan). NOTE: DDEX1-9 p.1 cover blurb says 'east of Phlan' - that line is contradicted by its own body text and is treated as an error. Described as little more than a hard-trodden trail; runs along the northern shore of the Moonsea, spanning the entirety of Stormy Bay.
